SURIOTA MODULE – WASTEWATER LOGGER

应用场景

Where Wastewater Logger is deployed

WWTP & STP Industrial Effluent Sewage Networks KLHK SPARING Sites Mining Tailings F&B Wastewater Textile Effluent Hospital Wastewater
Optimize Your Water Management with the Latest Technology

介绍 Suriota 最新的 Wastewater Logger,一款支持 Modbus RS232、SDI-12、Wi-Fi 和蓝牙协议的强大设备,实现无缝集成。该记录器支持实时数据 monitoring, resource utilization optimization, and anomaly detection with ease.

With wireless connectivity, you can access and control this device remotely, ensuring more efficient and responsive water management.

Suriota 的 Wastewater Logger V.3 可将您的水资源管理提升到新水平。通过我们的创新解决方案提高运营效率并确保环境合规。

核心功能

Why operators choose Wastewater Logger

01

Multi-Parameter Logging

Logs pH, TDS, Flow, Pressure, Level via Modbus RS-485 sensor inputs. Configurable channels and sampling intervals.

02

4G + WiFi Connectivity

Cellular 4G LTE for remote sites, WiFi for local network. Auto-failover ensures continuous data upload.

03

KLHK SPARING Ready

Pre-configured for KLHK SPARING reporting. Compliance-ready effluent data submission per Permen LHK No. 80/2019.

04

Battery Backup + Cloud Sync

Internal Li-ion battery keeps logging during outages. Cloud sync resumes automatically when power/network returns.

05

Multi-Protocol Sensor Support

Supports Modbus RS232, SDI-12, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth for diverse sensor integration. Plus onboard temperature & humidity sensors.

06

Solar Charging Compatible

Built-in solar charging support with charging indicator and battery connector. Perfect for remote off-grid sites.

常见问题

Wastewater Logger | Frequently Asked Questions

Is the logger KLHK SPARING-ready?
是。预配置为根据 Permen LHK No. 80/2019 进行 KLHK SPARING 报告。合规就绪的数据提交,具有正确的采样间隔、参数映射和政府服务器集成, the box.
What sensors does it support?
Supports pH, TDS, Conductivity, Flow, Pressure, Level via Modbus RS-485 inputs. Compatible with multi-brand sensors (Hach, Endress+Hauser, Krohne, Yokogawa). Configurable channels and sampling intervals per site.
Does it work without continuous internet?
Yes. Internal Li-ion battery keeps logging during power outages. Local storage buffers data when network is unavailable. Cloud sync resumes automatically when power and connectivity are restored.
What connectivity options are available?
4G LTE cellular for remote sites + WiFi 2.4GHz for local network. Auto-failover ensures continuous data upload. SIM card slot accepts any Indonesian carrier (Telkomsel, XL, Indosat, Smartfren).
